decisions.rationale: Engaged admin: reached first project on day 1 and replied positively with no blockers [email:34a46d71], no tickets. But 6 days in with no invite and no key milestone, solo Starter user still "getting used to the layout", and only 8 days left -- momentum is mild, not strong [email:6317f9b4].

draft.subject: Re: Checking in on Silver Systems' setup
draft.body:
Hi Isla,

Glad to hear things are going well and that the layout is starting to click -- that's normal in the first week.

Since your first project is up, the usual next step is getting real work into it: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. If it's useful, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, so you're not the only one in there.

Would a short call this week help? Fifteen minutes and I can walk through whatever part of the setup is least obvious right now.

Best,
Priya
